notes.title: Update v1.5: Guesser Paper and Stickers
notes.notes:
Hey Divers! 🤿  Thank you for playing our game! 🐙
We worked on visuals improvement! We update the Kraken's Guesser with new paper style. We also replace Talks by Stickers.
Your feedbacks really help us to improve the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300283/a40a630d8c2221abcd18b553ca7b8b3bc2248c85.gif[/img]

In Game:
  [list]
  [*] Add - Final guess effect
  [*] Add - Show opponent's hand before pick and play
  [*] Add - Guess ink sprites behind Kraken
  [*] Update - Stickers Diver, replace Talks
  [*] Update - Kraken's guesser paper and anim
  [*] Update - Kraken's guesser values hand-drawn font
  [*] Update - Kraken's guesser values anim on guess
  [*] Fix - Layer kraken & guess
  [/list]
Cards:
  [list]
  [*] Add - Dynamic shadow on cards
  [*] Update - Glow effect
  [*] Update - Hint fade anim
  [*] Update - Boost bubble show boost value instead of boost count
  [*] Update - Boost bubble font
  [/list]
Deck:
  [list]
  [*] Update - Resize deck pick scale
  [/list]
UI:
  [list]
  [*] Update - Camera UI scale per resolution keep 16/9
  [*] Update - Pre-Game screen font
  [*] Update - Cursors sprite management
  [/list]
Sounds:
  [list]
  [*] Add - Show hand sounds
  [*] Add - Stickers sounds
  [/list]
Tech:
  [list]
  [*] Remove - Touch screen while fix
  [/list]

We will keep updating the game as we have planned a few things to improve the game experience.
